svg.title: Enterprise LLM Gateway — logical component diagram
svg.desc: Four lanes: Users and Applications, Gateway components, Internal Resources, and External LLMs. Authentication is first. Public models are reached only via controlled egress.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Users and applications enter the Gateway. Internal resources stay in-boundary. Public LLMs are reached only after Policy and DLP allow egress.
